description: Split-flap departure-board text for React Native: every letter rolls, flips or flickers into place, played natively (Core Animation on iOS, Canvas on Android)
rules: Install and import the scoped package @enavermate/react-native-splitflap; the unscoped name react-native-splitflap is not this package
Requires the React Native New Architecture (Fabric), React Native 0.81+; there is no old-architecture fallback
In Expo use a development build (Expo SDK 54+): the library has native code and does not run in Expo Go. No config plugin and no native project changes are needed
transition="flip" requires surfaceColor, the background colour right under the text; TypeScript enforces it wherever the transition can be flip
flip and scramble do not accept cellWidth="natural"; direction applies to reel and roll only
The only peers are react and react-native; do not add Reanimated, Skia or any animation library for it
On the web the component renders a plain <Text>; right-to-left scripts are not supported
